name: Do I need to paint my walls before or after baseboard installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to paint my walls before or after baseboard installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can paint your walls either before or after baseboard installation, but painting walls first often simplifies the process. If you paint before, you avoid needing to meticulously tape off newly installed baseboards. After installation, the baseboards themselves will need to be painted, often after caulking and filling nail holes, to achieve a finished look. This sequence helps ensure clean lines and a professional finish, preventing paint from getting onto your new baseboards or requiring extensive touch-ups.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting walls before baseboard installation can simplify the process, with baseboards painted after installation, caulking, and nail hole filling.
